Rest easy, devotees of the diamond -- MLB Network has you covered. "Quick Pitch" not only provides complete highlights of each game from the previous day, but also presents a glimpse at upcoming contests, including pitching matchups. (Baseball)

programme.title: The Leadoff Spot (Live)
programme.desc: Co-hosted by a combination of veteran baseball analysts - Steve Phillips, Xavier Scruggs and Eduardo Pérez - the program will deliver expert commentary, plus interviews with baseball newsmakers and club personnel. (Sports talk, Talk)

programme.title: MLB Central (Live)
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever regular-season morning show features hosts Robert Flores, Mark DeRosa and Lauren Shehadi reporting from Studio 21, named in honor of Hall of Famer and humanitarian Roberto Clemente. Updates and context on the latest news, extensive on-field highlights, and long-form conversations with guests, celebrities and insiders from around baseball are presented each weekday morning. Flores joined the network in 2016 as a host/reporter, DeRosa offers a unique outlook as a former player, and Shehadi honed crisp interviewing skills during three years of hosting MLB Network's "The Rundown." (Baseball)

programme.title: MLB Now (Live)
programme.desc: The hourlong weekday afternoon "MLB Now" presents the day's top stories in baseball by spanning the sport's cultural divide. Host Brian Kenny discusses the issues and provides analysis, with a bent toward modern analytics to prove his points. The series also features interviews with personalities throughout the game, and viewer opinions are welcome as well via social media polls. (Baseball)

programme.title: Intentional Talk (Live)
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever talk show is an open forum that features some talk and a lot of banter each weekday for host Kevin Millar, who discusses with special guests what's hot and what's not in and around the national pastime. He also runs out of the baseline at times by welcoming guests from the worlds of entertainment and pop culture to talk about trending topics in those arenas. Millar gained fame as a member of the 2004 world champion Boston Red Sox, and since he retired from the diamond his knowledge of the game and warm, affable personality have vaulted him into a lengthy career in the media. (Baseball)

programme.title: MLB Tonight (Live)
programme.desc: When they're not tuning in to the games themselves, baseball fans know where to turn for their nightly baseball fix. MLB Network's signature program, "MLB Tonight" presents complete coverage of all of the games, beginning with the first pitch on the East Coast and ending with the final out on the West Coast. The Emmy-winning studio show features highlights, live look-ins and breaking news, plus analysis from a rotating roster of hosts, former players and inside information men. (Baseball)

programme.title: Breaking Down Barriers - The Legacy of Willie O'Ree
programme.desc: On January 18, 1958, Willie O'Ree made history with the Boston Bruins as the first black player to skate in a National Hockey League game. O'Ree went on to play professional hockey for 21 years, shattering a barrier that had stood for over 40 years and inspiring generations of young athletes to pursue their dreams. Willie didn't just play the game, he changed it forever. (Sports talk)

programme.title: Breaking Down Barriers - The Herb Carnegie Story
programme.desc: Herb Carnegie is regarded by many as the best black player to never reach the NHL. His legacy transcends the confines of the rink, inspiring generations with his resilience and unwavering passion for the game. (Sports talk)

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Pup Pup Goose; Pup Pup and Away
programme.desc: S1E5 - Marshall's new gosling friend gets lost; the PAW Patrol must rescue the mayor from a hot air balloon.

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Pups Save the Mustache; Pups Save the Funhouse
programme.desc: S8E5 - The Pups must help to find Mayor Humdinger's mustache after he accidentally shaves it off; after a carnival train gets stuck in a tunnel, it results in a mountainside funhouse-style wild ride.

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Pups Save a Floundering Francois; Pups Save the Pop-Up Penguins
programme.desc: S2E22 - Cap'n Turbot and his cousin Francois are watching white whales in Adventure Bay when their boat hits a rock and starts to sink; the PAW Patrol must track down some loose penguins and help them return to the land of ice and snow.

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Pups Save the Polar Bears; A Pup in Sheep's Clothing
programme.desc: S3E11 - The pups fly to the Arctic in order to rescue lost polar bear cubs; the Patrol needs to find lost sheep and learn who has been making holes in a fence.

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Pups Save a Space Rock; Pups Save a Good Mayor
programme.desc: S4E17 - Everest, the Turbots and a Space Rock get trapped in a cave; when Mayor Goodway goes missing, Mayor Humdinger causes havoc in Adventure Bay.

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Pups Save Their Floating Friends; Pups Save a Satellite
programme.desc: S3E26 - Ryder and the pups must repair the aliens' spaceship and get everyone back to Earth; when a satellite begins to fall toward Adventure Bay, the PAW Patrol have to fix it before it crashes.

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Pups Save the Mail; Pups Save a Frog Mayor
programme.desc: S4E20 - When the postman's truck gets stuck in the mud, the mail is stuck in a tree; Mayor Goodway turns into a frog.

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Ultimate Rescue: Pups Save a Runaway Stargazer
programme.desc: S5E25 - A comet is coming, and the PAW Patrol gets to work building a giant observatory; when the observatory starts rolling out of control, Rubble and the pups need to rebuild everything it has destroyed.

programme.title: Rubble & Crew - The Crew Builds a Pancake Café; The Crew Builds a Duck Plane Wash
programme.desc: S4E9 - Rubble and Crew want to make the biggest pancake ever; but it's a sticky situation when Speed Meister wants to beat them to it. When Camila's plane gets dirty from leading migrating ducks home, the pups find a way to wash the plane in the sky.

programme.title: Rubble & Crew - The Crew Builds a Skyscraper Parts 1 & 2
programme.desc: S3E6 - Rubble and crew are building their biggest construction project ever, a skyscraper; and a job that huge calls for brand-new, mega-sized construction vehicles; but when Speed Meister sees the pups' big trucks, he calls in help from his big brother.

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Pups Save a Frozen Camp-Out; Pups Save the Fizzy Pickles
programme.desc: S5E23 - A freak snowstorm hits while Alex and Mr. Porter are camping on a tropical island; Mr. Porter is delivering his fizzy pickles to people around town when a bumpy road shakes up the deliveries and causes the pickle juice to spill.

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Pups Save the Bay; Pups Save a Goodway
programme.desc: S1E14 - Ryder and the PAW Patrol clean up an oil spill in the water near Adventure Bay; the PAW Patrol must help Mayor Goodway get a statue from the bottom of the bay.

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Pups and the Kitty-tastrophe; Pups Save a Train
programme.desc: S1E3 - Ryder and the PAW Patrol rescue a lost kitty from the bay; Ryder, Rubble and Rocky must help free Katie and Cali's train from a rockslide.

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Skye's Road Trip Rescue
programme.desc: S11E25 - Skye, Liberty and Everest take off on a road trip to Yellowstone National Park and need to use their mini-rescue rides to save a bunch of baby animals.

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Fire Rescue: Pups Save the Big BBQ
programme.desc: S11E18 - Adventure Bay gets a fire station; when disaster strikes during the opening day BBQ, it's up to the PAW Patrol in their new fire rescue gear and vehicles to put it out.

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Pups Save a Humsquatch; Pups Save a Far Flung Flying Disc
programme.desc: S6E22 - When Travelling Travis yelps for help when he finds a mysterious creature in trouble, the PAW Patrol heads to Foggy Bottom to save a Humsquatch; when a robo-toy causes mayhem in Adventure Bay, Ryder knows just who to call.

programme.title: Peppa Pig - Pedro the Cowboy; Grandpa Pig's Train to the Rescue; Spider Web; Wishing Well; Lost Keys
programme.desc: Peppa and her family visit a new theme park; Miss Rabbit's train breaks down; Mummy Pig finds a spider in the house; Granny Pig orders gnomes and a wishing well for her garden; Daddy Pig loses his car keys.

programme.title: Peppa Pig - Pen Pal; Granny and Grandpa's Attic; The Quarrel; The Toy Cupboard; School Camp
programme.desc: Peppa has a pen pal; Peppa and George help their grandparents clean their attic; Peppa and Suzy Sheep argue; Peppa and George's toy basket is too full; Peppa and her friends go camping.

programme.title: Peppa Pig - The Outback; Surfing; The Great Barrier Reef; The Boomerang; Nature Trail
programme.desc: Peppa, George, Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig go to visit the Kangaroo family in Australia and get to explore the Outback.

programme.title: Peppa Pig - Peppa's Circus; Night Animals; Pirate Treasure; Garden Games; Going Boating
programme.desc: Peppa and her friends put on a circus; Peppa and George stay up late to hunt for slugs and snails; Pirate Peppa buries a treasure chest; Daddy Pig gives Peppa an old box of garden games; everyone goes boating at the lake.

programme.title: Bubble Guppies - Ninja Season!
programme.desc: S5E11 - Gil wants to be a ninja, but his ninja teacher just keeps giving him random tasks to do; frustrated, Gil is about to give up when another ninja challenges him, and he realizes he's been learning ninja skills all along.

programme.title: Bubble Guppies - A Tooth on the Looth!
programme.desc: S2E8 - Deema has a loose tooth; the Guppies learn about keeping a healthy smile.

programme.title: Bubble Guppies - Ocean Patrol!
programme.desc: S5E5 - The Ocean Patrol tries to stop Windy Pete when he sails around the world and blasts tropical climates with snow.

programme.title: Bubble Guppies - Get Ready for School!
programme.desc: S3E1 - Oona's friend is worried about his first day of school; the guppies reveal that school is a great place to learn, play and meet new friends.

programme.title: Bubble Guppies - The New Doghouse!
programme.desc: S4E3 - When an accident destroys Bubble Puppy's doghouse, the Guppies team up with the entire neighborhood to build Bubble Puppy's dream home.

programme.title: Bubble Guppies - The Kingdom of Laughs-a-Lot!
programme.desc: S6E13 - Jesters Goby and Gil arrive in the Kingdom of NeverLaugh, where King Grumpfish decrees that he'll outlaw laughter if no one can make him laugh before sundown.

programme.title: Bubble Guppies - Dragons N' Roses!
programme.desc: S5E10 - When Petunia the Dragon moves to the Kingdom of Flowers, everyone is afraid of her fearsome roar except for Zooli, who befriends Petunia and shows her friends how lovable Petunia really is.

programme.title: Bubble Guppies - The Mighty, Untidy Titans!
programme.desc: S5E15 - When some untidy Titans (played by Guppies) start messing up Zooli, Nonny and Oona's goat farm, the goat herders must journey to the Titans' cloud realm to ask them to tidy up.

programme.title: Bubble Guppies - The SS Friendship!
programme.desc: S6E6 - Capt. Deema and first mate Gil pilot their steampunk sub to different ocean habitats so they can deliver Friendship Day bubblegrams to all their friends; along the way, they find themselves being chased by a kraken.

programme.title: Bubble Guppies - The Cowgirl Parade!
programme.desc: S2E6 - Molly wants to be a cowgirl like Dusty.

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Pups Save a High Flying Hen; Pups Save a Sloth
programme.desc: S10E2 - After Chickaletta accidentally takes flight on a toy airplane, it's up to the team to rescue her; Mayor Humdinger mistakes a sloth for a monkey, racing to find it and cover up his blunder.

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Pups Save the Chicken Conductor; Pups Save the Digi Tal Stylists
programme.desc: S11E16 - Chickaletta is left driving the train after an enormous chicken floaty launches Engineer Ed out the window; when Katie needs to close the Pet Parlor early, Digi and Tal volunteer to keep the shop open.

programme.title: Rubble & Crew - The Crew Fixes the Talent Show Stage; The Crew Builds Instruments
programme.desc: S1E22 - When Speed Meister sabotages the stage for the town talent show, the pups use Motor's talent to save the day; Sierra Sparkle comes to sing for Builder Cove Day, but when the band's instruments break, Rubble & Crew have a construction solution.

programme.title: Rubble & Crew - The Crew Builds a Drive-In Movie Theater; The Crew Finds a Rainbow Treasure
programme.desc: S1E9 - When Mix and Motor's favorite TV star has a new movie playing in Builder Cove, the pups need to build a movie theater to watch it; Grandpa tells the pups about a buried treasure, and they find out the key to finding this treasure is teamwork.

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Rubble and Wild in a Yarn of a Tail; Skye and Rory Flip It; Marshall and Leo Save the Ferris Wheel Passengers; Everest and Shade Save a Mountain Goat
programme.desc: S8E25 - Rubble and Wild team up to stop a giant runaway yarn ball rolling through town; Marshall and Leo must rescue some critters stuck on a Ferris wheel.

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Pups Save the Floating Goodways; Pups Save the Portable Pet Wash
programme.desc: S8E23 - The Goodways drift out to sea on a swan-shaped float and need rescue from a flock of real swans aiming to protect the giant inflatable; Mayor Humdinger steals Katie's Portable Pet Wash and ends up causing bubble trouble all over town.

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Rocky's Cat-astrophe
programme.desc: When one of Humdinger's schemes goes awry, a Junkyard Kitten's home is destroyed and Rocky bites off more than he can chew when he invites the kitten to stay at the Lookout overnight.

programme.title: Rubble & Crew - The Crew and Marshall Build a Fire Station
programme.desc: S1E11 - Rubble & Crew build Builder Cove's first ever Fire Station, complete with an inspection from PAW Patrol's Marshall; when Speed Meister's sneaky sabotage traps Marshall's Fire Truck, the pups work together to put out a fire construction-style.

programme.title: Rubble & Crew - The Crew Builds a Roller Coaster; The Crew Builds Motor a Play Space
programme.desc: S2E1 - When Speed Meister's roller coaster sends a pet play date out of control, Rubble and Crew save the day with a bigger, better and safer coaster; the Bark Yard safety inspection is today, but Motor going boom could cost the crew.

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Pups Save the Honey; Pups Save Mayor Goodway's Purse
programme.desc: S6E4 - Yumi's Yummy Honey is all the buzz when it -- and her beehive -- go missing from her farm; Mayor Goodway's purse disappears, along with its precious cargo, Chickaletta.

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Hum-Patrol to the Rescue!; Pups Save Morning Mountain Yoga
programme.desc: S11E19 - When Adventure Bay holds a raffle, a pair of nest-building seagulls snatch the winning prize; a rockslide leaves Mayor Goodway, Farmer Yumi and Garby stranded on the side of a mountain.

programme.title: Nightwatch
programme.desc: Law student Martin Bells (Ewan McGregor) needs to make some money, and so he takes a side job as a night watchman in a morgue. He thinks he'll have time to study, but with a serial killer on the loose -- one with a propensity for necrophilia -- he has to be more alert than ever. While at work, Martin starts putting together the clues and realizes that the police, including Inspector Thomas Cray (Nick Nolte), have good reason to make him their prime suspect. - Ewan McGregor, Nick Nolte, Josh Brolin, Patricia Arquette, Alix Koromzay (Horror, Drama)

programme.title: Friday the 13th, Part 2
programme.desc: The second entry in the long-running horror series focuses on a group of teenage would-be counselors converging on Camp Crystal Lake for training under the tutelage of head counselor Paul (John Furey). Inevitably, Paul relates the story of Jason Voorhees (Warrington Gillette), a boy who ostensibly drowned at the camp and whose mother murdered a group of counselors in revenge. No one takes the tale seriously until a very much alive Jason begins gruesomely eliminating people. - Amy Steel, John Furey, Adrienne King, Kirsten Baker, Stuart Charno (Horror, Action, Mystery, Crime drama, Thriller)

programme.title: John Carpenter's Escape From L.A.
programme.desc: In 2013, the United States president was exiling all citizens who don't conform to his hyper-conservative views to Los Angeles, which became an island after a huge earthquake. But, when the president's daughter nabs the detonator to her dad's apocalyptic weapon and sneaks into L.A. to be with the rebel leader she loves, the government taps commando-turned-crook Snake Plissken to retrieve the young woman. And, if he doesn't succeed quickly, he'll be executed. - Kurt Russell, Stacy Keach, Steve Buscemi, Cliff Robertson, Peter Fonda (Action, Adventure, Science fiction, Thriller)

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-head Do America
programme.desc: Two of the biggest animated slackers around, Beavis (Mike Judge) and Butt-head (also Judge) get a kick-start when two crooks steal their TV. On their mission to find a replacement, Beavis and Butt-head wind up in the motel of Muddy Grimes (Bruce Willis), where a case of mistaken identity has them after his wife, Dallas (Demi Moore). Due to misunderstanding Grimes when he says to "do" his wife, the two travel from Las Vegas to Washington, not realizing they've been sent out to kill the woman. - John Doman (Animated, Comedy)

programme.title: Rango
programme.desc: A chameleon who has lived as a sheltered family pet finds himself in the grip of an identity crisis. Rango wonders how to stand out when it is his nature to blend in. When he accidentally winds up in a frontier town called Dirt, he takes the first step on a transformational journey as the town's new sheriff. Though at first Rango only role-plays, a series of thrilling situations and outrageous encounters forces him to become a real hero. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure)

programme.title: The Perfect Gamble
programme.desc: Released from prison, two gamblers get entangled with the mafia when they decide to open an illegal casino. - David Arquette, Danny A. Abeckaser, Daniella Pick Tarantino, Dean Miroshnikov, Herzl Tobey (Crime drama)

programme.title: Terminator: Dark Fate
programme.desc: In Mexico City, a newly modified liquid Terminator -- the Rev-9 model -- arrives from the future to kill a young factory worker named Dani Ramos. Also sent back in time is Grace, a hybrid cyborg human who must protect Ramos from the seemingly indestructible robotic assassin. But the two women soon find some much-needed help from a pair of unexpected allies -- seasoned warrior Sarah Connor and the T-800 Terminator. - Linda Hamilton, Arnold Schwarzenegger, Mackenzie Davis, Natalia Reyes, Gabriel Luna (Science fiction, Action)

programme.title: The Yards
programme.desc: After serving time in prison for taking the fall for a group of his friends, Leo just wants to get his life back on track. So he goes to the one place he thinks will be safe -- home. There he takes a new job with his highly connected and influential uncle. But in the yards, where his uncle now pulls the strings, safe is not how they do business. Unwittingly, he's drawn into a world of sabotage, high stakes payoffs and even murder. - Mark Wahlberg, Joaquin Phoenix, Charlize Theron, James Caan, Ellen Burstyn (Crime drama)

programme.title: The Dictator
programme.desc: Gen. Aladeen (Sacha Baron Cohen) has ruled the oil-rich North African country of Wadiya since the age of six, when 97 stray bullets and a hand grenade killed his father in a hunting accident. After an assassination attempt takes the life of yet another body-double, Tamir (Ben Kingsley), Aladeen's uncle and most trusted adviser, convinces Aladeen to go to New York. Unfortunately, Aladeen has a less-than-friendly reception from exiled Wadiyans, who want their country freed from his despotic rule. - Sacha Baron Cohen, Anna Faris, Ben Kingsley, Jason Mantzoukas, Kevin Corrigan (Comedy)

programme.title: Get Hard
programme.desc: When a rich hedge-fund manager, James, is convicted of fraud and sentenced to a stretch in San Quentin, the judge gives him one month to get his affairs in order. Knowing that he won't survive more than a few minutes in prison on his own, James turns to Darnell, a Black businessman who's never even had a parking ticket, for help. As Darnell puts James through the wringer, both learn that they were wrong about many things, including each other. - Will Ferrell, Kevin Hart, Craig T. Nelson, Alison Brie, Edwina Findley (Comedy)

programme.title: The Hangover Part II
programme.desc: Two years after the disastrous events in Las Vegas, it is now Stu's (Ed Helms) turn to walk down the aisle. Since his bride is from Thailand, Stu decides to hold the wedding there. Desperately hoping to avoid the mayhem of Doug's (Justin Bartha) bachelor party, Stu chooses what he thinks will be a safe option: an alcohol-free, pre-wedding brunch. But this being Thailand, and with Phil (Bradley Cooper) and Alan (Zach Galifianakis) again in attendance, anything can happen. - Bradley Cooper, Ed Helms, Zach Galifianakis, Justin Bartha, Ken Jeong (Comedy)

programme.title: Best in Show
programme.desc: The tension is palpable, the excitement is mounting and the heady scent of competition is in the air as hundreds of eager contestants from across America prepare to take part in what is undoubtedly one of the greatest events of their lives -- the Mayflower Dog Show. The canine contestants and their owners are as wondrously diverse as the great country that has bred them. - Michael Hitchcock, Parker Posey, Eugene Levy, Catherine O'Hara, Christopher Guest (Comedy, LGBTQ)

programme.title: Swingers
programme.desc: A transplanted New Yorker attempting to acclimate to Los Angeles, Mike Peters (Jon Favreau), is struggling to both boost his comedy career and get over his last relationship. A self-proclaimed master of seduction, Mike's buddy, Trent Walker (Vince Vaughn), tries to show him how to make connections and get the attention of women. Slowly moving toward regaining his confidence, Mike meets the gorgeous and down-to-earth Lorraine (Heather Graham), sparking a welcome new romance. - Jon Favreau, Vince Vaughn, Ron Livingston, Patrick Van Horn, Alex Désert (Comedy, Drama)

programme.title: Clerks
programme.desc: Dante (Brian O'Halloran) is called in to cover a shift at his New Jersey convenience store on his day off. His friend Randal (Jeff Anderson) helps him pass the time, neglecting his video-store customers next door to hang out in the Quick Stop. The uneventful day is disrupted by news that one of Dante's ex-girlfriends has died. After attending her memorial service, Dante muses over staying with current girlfriend Veronica (Marilyn Ghigliotti) or reuniting with ex Caitlin (Lisa Spoonhauer). - Brian O'Halloran, Jeff Anderson, Marilyn Ghigliotti, Lisa Spoonhauer, Jason Mewes (Comedy)

programme.title: Maniac
programme.desc: A serial killer (Elijah Wood) removes his victims' scalps and attaches them to the vintage mannequins he restores in his late mother's shop. - Elijah Wood, Nora Arnezeder, Megan Duffy, Jan Broberg, Genevieve Alexandra (Horror)

programme.title: The Autopsy of Jane Doe
programme.desc: When father and son coroners investigate the death of a beautiful "Jane Doe," they find increasingly bizarre clues. - Emile Hirsch, Brian Cox, Ophelia Lovibond, Michael McElhatton, Olwen Kelly (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: Bleed for This
programme.desc: Vinny "The Pazmanian Devil" Pazienza (Miles Teller), a local Providence boxer, shoots to stardom after winning two world title fights. After a near-fatal car accident leaves him with a broken neck, he is told he may never walk again. Against all odds and doctor's orders, renowned trainer Kevin Rooney (Aaron Eckhart) agrees to help Vinny return to the ring just a year after the accident for what could be the last fight of his life. Based on a true story. - Miles Teller, Aaron Eckhart, Katey Sagal, Ciarán Hinds, Ted Levine (Biography, Drama)

programme.title: The Argument
programme.desc: When a couple argue about a party and neither will back down, they decide to re-create the evening to determine who is right. - Dan Fogler, Maggie Q, Danny Pudi, Emma Bell, Tyler James Williams (Comedy)

programme.title: Proof
programme.desc: Catherine (Gwyneth Paltrow) is a 27-year-old grieving after the loss of her father (Anthony Hopkins), a genius mathematician whose mind gradually deteriorated from mental illness. With her sister, Claire (Hope Davis), urging Catherine to leave their family home, and an ambitious student (Jake Gyllenhaal) searching through her father's notes, Catherine struggles to keep her composure and her sanity in this drama adapted from the stage play by David Auburn. - Gwyneth Paltrow, Anthony Hopkins, Jake Gyllenhaal, Hope Davis, Gary Houston (Drama)

programme.title: Barron's Cove
programme.desc: A man with a violent past kidnaps the boy he holds responsible for his son's death. As he grows closer to uncovering the truth, he's left to wonder whether his pursuers are really seeking to protect the boy, or merely the secrets he keeps. - Garrett Hedlund, Hamish Linklater, Brittany Snow, Christian Convery, Tramell Tillman (Crime drama, Thriller)

programme.title: A.I.: Artificial Intelligence
programme.desc: A robotic boy, the first programmed to love, David is adopted as a test case by a Cybertronics employee and his wife. Though he gradually becomes their child, a series of unexpected circumstances make this life impossible for David. Without final acceptance by humans or machines, David embarks on a journey to discover where he truly belongs, uncovering a world in which the line between robot and machine is both vast and profoundly thin. - Haley Joel Osment, Jude Law, Frances O'Connor, Brendan Gleeson, Sam Robards (Science fiction, Fantasy, Drama, Adventure, Thriller)

programme.title: Escape From Alcatraz
programme.desc: Frank Morris (Clint Eastwood), a hardened con with a history of prison breaks, is sent to serve the rest of his life sentence at Alcatraz -- America's most infamously brutal and inescapable maximum security prison. Morris quickly realizes the prison's dehumanizing effects and clashes with its cruel warden (Patrick McGoohan). Fed up with life at Alcatraz, Morris and two convict brothers (Fred Ward, Jack Thibeau) meticulously plan the unthinkable: an escape from the island. - Clint Eastwood, Patrick McGoohan, Jack Thibeau, Roberts Blossom, Fred Ward (Thriller, Action, Historical drama)

programme.title: The Seven Five
programme.desc: Former NYPD officer Michael Dowd tells how he and his partner committed a long list of crimes, including running their own cocaine ring, while on the job in the 1980s and early '90s. (Documentary, Biography)

programme.title: The Aviator
programme.desc: Billionaire and aviation tycoon Howard Hughes (Leonardo DiCaprio) is a successful public figure: a director of big-budget Hollywood films such as "Hell's Angels," a passionate lover of Hollywood leading ladies Katharine Hepburn (Cate Blanchett) and Ava Gardner (Kate Beckinsale), and an aviation pioneer who helps build TWA into a major airline. But in private, Hughes remains tormented, suffering from paralyzing phobias and depression. The higher he rises, the farther has to fall. - Leonardo DiCaprio, Cate Blanchett, Kate Beckinsale, John C. Reilly, Alec Baldwin (Biography, Historical drama)

programme.title: Dunkirk
programme.desc: In May 1940, Germany advanced into France, trapping Allied troops on the beaches of Dunkirk. Under air and ground cover from British and French forces, troops were slowly and methodically evacuated from the beach using every serviceable naval and civilian vessel that could be found. At the end of this heroic mission, 330,000 French, British, Belgian and Dutch soldiers were safely evacuated. - Fionn Whitehead, Tom Glynn-Carney, Jack Lowden, Harry Styles, Aneurin Barnard (War, Historical drama, Action)

programme.title: The English Patient
programme.desc: A Hungarian count's (Ralph Fiennes) fling with a British newlywed leads to tragedy in World War II North Africa.

programme.title: Ask the Dust
programme.desc: In Depression-era Los Angeles, a fiery Mexican waitress (Salma Hayek) who wants to improve her lot through marriage meets an aspiring writer (Colin Farrell) of Italian descent.

programme.title: The Woman in Black
programme.desc: A widowed lawyer (Daniel Radcliffe) encounters ghostly goings-on at the foreboding estate of a recently deceased client.

programme.title: Scary Movie V
programme.desc: Bizarre activity follows after a husband and wife bring their newborn baby home from the hospital. Realizing that a demon is stalking their family, they consult paranormal experts and install numerous cameras to drive the spirit out.

programme.title: Crawlspace
programme.desc: After witnessing a brutal murder in a cabin, a man hides in a crawlspace while the killers scour the property for a hidden fortune. As they draw nearer, he must decide if the crawlspace will be his tomb or the battleground in his fight for survival.

programme.title: Winchester
programme.desc: Ensconced in her sprawling San Jose, California mansion, eccentric firearm heiress Sarah Winchester believes she is haunted by the souls of people killed by the Winchester repeating rifle.

programme.title: Teaching Mrs. Tingle
programme.desc: With their futures threatened by false accusations of cheating, three teenagers take matters into their own hands.

programme.title: Case 39
programme.desc: A social worker (Renée Zellweger) saves a girl (Jodelle Ferland) from abusive parents but finds there is more to the child than meets the eye.

programme.title: Out of the Furnace
programme.desc: A steelworker (Christian Bale) takes matters into his own hands when his brother (Casey Affleck) joins one of the Northeast's most-ruthless crime syndicates, then disappears.

programme.title: For Greater Glory: The True Story of Cristiada
programme.desc: In the 1920s, the Mexican government's attempt to secularize the country sparks a rebellion known as the Cristero War.

programme.title: Blade Runner 2049
programme.desc: After discovering a long-buried secret that jeopardizes what's left of society, a new Blade Runner embarks on a quest to find Rick Deckard, a former Blade Runner who's been missing for 30 years.

programme.title: Sweet Virginia
programme.desc: An ex-rodeo rider strikes up a friendship with a young man who may be behind the violence occurring in their small town. - Jon Bernthal, Christopher Abbott, Imogen Poots, Rosemarie DeWitt, Odessa Young (Thriller, Drama)

programme.title: Scream 3
programme.desc: In the final installment of this trilogy, a murder spree begins to happen again; this time targeted toward the original Woodsboro survivors and those associated with the movie-inside-a-movie, Stab 3. Sydney must face the demons of her past to stop the killer. - David Arquette, Neve Campbell, Courteney Cox Arquette, Patrick Dempsey, Scott Foley (Horror, Comedy, Mystery)

programme.title: Scary Movie V
programme.desc: Much bizarre activity follows after a husband and wife bring their newborn infant home from the hospital. When they realize that a demon is stalking their family, they consult paranormal specialists and install numerous cameras to drive out the pesky spirit. Movies that are spoofed in the familiar format include the "Paranormal Activity" franchise, "Mama," "Sinister," "Evil Dead," "Inception," "Black Swan" and "Rise of the Planet of the Apes." - Ashley Tisdale, Simon Rex, Erica Ash, Katt Williams, Gracie Whitton (Comedy)

programme.title: Waking Up in Reno
programme.desc: Candy (Charlize Theron) and Lonnie Earl (Billy Bob Thornton) are just crazy about each other. The problem: she's married to Roy (Patrick Swayze) and he's married to Darlene (Natasha Richardson). So far it's been a secret affair. But that's about to change, because this foursome is driving cross-country and headed for some big surprises. - Billy Bob Thornton, Charlize Theron, Natasha Richardson, Patrick Swayze, Holmes Osborne (Romantic comedy)

programme.title: Airplane!
programme.desc: This spoof comedy takes shots at the slew of disaster movies that were released in the 70s. When the passengers and crew of a jet are incapacitated due to food poisoning, a rogue pilot with a drinking problem must cooperate with his ex-girlfriend turned stewardess to bring the plane to a safe landing. - Robert Hays, Julie Hagerty, Peter Graves, Robert Stack, Lloyd Bridges (Dark comedy)

programme.title: Overdrive
programme.desc: A notorious crime boss forces two legendary car thieves to steal a vehicle to win back their freedom. Joined by two beautiful women, the team has one week to pull off the daring heist or risk losing everything, including their lives. - Scott Eastwood, Freddie Thorp, Ana de Armas, Gaia Weiss, Simon Abkarian (Action, Thriller)

programme.title: Chuck
programme.desc: He was the pride of Bayonne, N.J., a man who went 15 rounds in the ring with Muhammad Ali. But before all of that, Chuck Wepner was a liquor salesman and father with a modest prizefighting career whose life changed overnight when, in 1975, he was chosen to take on Ali in a highly publicized title match. It's the beginning of a wild ride through the exhilarating highs and humbling lows of sudden fame, but what happens when your 15 minutes in the spotlight are up? - Liev Schreiber, Elisabeth Moss, Naomi Watts, Ron Perlman, Jim Gaffigan (Biography, Historical drama)

programme.title: Breakdown
programme.desc: While traveling to California, Taylor and his wife, Amy, experience a vehicle malfunction on a remote highway. Amy Taylor accepts a ride from a truck driver to seek assistance while Jeff Taylor remains with the vehicle. When the couple fails to reunite at a designated location, Jeff Taylor begins a search for his wife despite a lack of assistance from local residents or law enforcement. - Kurt Russell, J.T. Walsh, Kathleen Quinlan, M.C. Gainey, Jack Noseworthy (Thriller, Mystery, Crime drama, Action, Adventure)

programme.title: Juice
programme.desc: Four Harlem friends -- Bishop (Tupac Shakur), Q (Omar Epps), Steel (Jermaine Hopkins) and Raheem (Khalil Kain) -- dabble in petty crime, but they decide to go big by knocking off a convenience store. Bishop, the magnetic leader of the group, has the gun. But Q has different aspirations. He wants to be a DJ and happens to have a gig the night of the robbery. Unfortunately for him, Bishop isn't willing to take no for answer in a game where everything's for keeps. - Omar Epps, Tupac Shakur, Jermaine Hopkins, Khalil Kain, Cindy Herron (Crime drama)

programme.title: Defiance
programme.desc: In 1941, Nazi soldiers are slaughtering Eastern European Jews by the thousands. Three brothers, Tuvia (Daniel Craig), Zus (Liev Schreiber) and Asael (Jamie Bell), manage to escape and take refuge in the forest where they played in childhood. Seeking a way to avenge the deaths of their loved ones, the brothers turn their daily struggle for survival into a battle against the Nazis. As news of their exploits spreads, others join the fray, willing to risk their lives for even brief freedom. - Daniel Craig, Liev Schreiber, Jamie Bell, Alexa Davalos, Allan Corduner (Historical drama, War)

programme.title: Faster
programme.desc: Following a 10-year prison stint, Driver (Dwayne Johnson) sprints through the gates to take vengeance on those responsible for his brother's murder. Within hours of dispatching his first one, he has two men on his tail: a veteran police officer (Billy Bob Thornton) and an eager assassin (Oliver Jackson-Cohen). Driver tries to stay a step ahead of his pursuers, but there are hints that his list is incomplete, and the unknown person may endanger his life. - Dwayne Johnson, Billy Bob Thornton, Oliver Jackson-Cohen, Carla Gugino, Maggie Grace (Action, Thriller)

programme.title: The Gambler
programme.desc: Literature professor Jim Bennett (Mark Wahlberg) leads a secret life as a high-stakes gambler. Always a risk-taker, Bennett bets it all when he borrows from a gangster and offers his own life as collateral. Staying one step ahead, he pits his creditor against the operator of an illicit gambling ring while garnering the attention of Frank (John Goodman), a paternalistic loan shark. As his relationship with a student (Brie Larson) deepens, Bennett must risk everything for a second chance. - Mark Wahlberg, John Goodman, Brie Larson, Michael Kenneth Williams, Jessica Lange (Crime drama)

programme.title: Molly's Game
programme.desc: The true story of Molly Bloom, a beautiful, young, Olympic-class skier who ran the world's most exclusive high-stakes poker game for a decade before being arrested in the middle of the night by 17 FBI agents wielding automatic weapons. Her players included Hollywood royalty, sports stars, business titans and finally, unbeknown to her, the Russian mob. Her only ally was her criminal defense lawyer Charlie Jaffey, who learned there was much more to Molly than the tabloids led people to believe. - Jessica Chastain, Idris Elba, Michael Cera, Kevin Costner, Jeremy Strong (Biography, Drama)

programme.title: Heist 88
programme.desc: A criminal mastermind decides to pull one last job before going to prison and recruits a group of young bank employees to steal millions in a daring and brazen assault on the U.S. banking system. - Courtney B. Vance, Keith David, Keesha Sharp, Rebecca Spence, Bentley Green (Crime drama)

programme.title: Fatal Attraction
programme.desc: For Dan Gallagher (Michael Douglas), life is good. He is on the rise at his New York law firm, is happily married to his wife, Beth (Anne Archer), and has a loving daughter. But, after a casual fling with a sultry book editor named Alex (Glenn Close), everything changes. Jilted by Dan, Alex becomes unstable, her behavior escalating from aggressive pursuit to obsessive stalking. Dan realizes that his main problem is not hiding his affair, but rather saving himself and his family. - Michael Douglas, Glenn Close, Anne Archer, Ellen Hamilton Latzen, Stuart Pankin (Thriller, Drama, Romance)

programme.title: Equilibrium
programme.desc: In a futuristic world, a regime has eliminated war by suppressing emotions: books, art and music are strictly forbidden and feeling is a crime punishable by death. Cleric John Preston is a top-ranking government agent responsible for destroying those who resist these rules. When he misses a dose of Prozium, a mind-altering drug that hinders emotion, Preston, who has been trained to enforce strict laws of the new regime, suddenly becomes the one capable of overthrowing it. - Christian Bale, Emily Watson, Taye Diggs, Angus Macfadyen, Sean Bean (Science fiction, Drama)

programme.title: Wild Wild West
programme.desc: When President Ulysses S. Grant (Kevin Kline) learns that diabolical inventor Dr. Arliss Loveless (Kenneth Branagh) is planning to assassinate him, he orders Civil War hero James West (Will Smith) and U.S. Marshal Artemus Gordon (also Kline) to arrest him. West's trigger-happy personality doesn't always mesh well with that of the thoughtful Gordon, but they manage to work together. And with the help of a mysterious stranger (Salma Hayek), West and Gordon close in on Loveless. - Will Smith, Kevin Kline, Kenneth Branagh, Salma Hayek, Ted Levine (Action, Western, Comedy, Adventure, Science fiction)

programme.title: All Up in the Biz
programme.desc: Celebrity interviews and rare archival footage provide insight into the life and legacy of hip-hop icon Biz Markie. (Documentary, Music, Hip-Hop & rap)

programme.title: The Firm
programme.desc: A young lawyer joins a small but prestigious law firm only to find out that most of their clients are on the wrong side of the law. The company is helping to launder mob money, get clients off charges and even murder partners who threaten to blow their cover, but when the FBI come calling to gather evidence on the lawyer's colleagues, he is caught between a rock and a hard place, juggling his life and his liberty. - Tom Cruise, Jeanne Tripplehorn, Gene Hackman, Holly Hunter, Ed Harris (Drama, Thriller, Mystery)

programme.title: The Cut
programme.desc: Given one last shot at glory, a former boxing champion has just six days to make weight for a title fight. His obsession soon leaves him at the mercy of a notorious trainer who takes every last ounce from his mind, body and soul. - Orlando Bloom, Caitriona Balfe, John Turturro, Clare Dunne, Gary Beadle (Thriller, Drama)

programme.title: Gangs of New York
programme.desc: Amsterdam Vallon (Leonardo DiCaprio) is a young Irish immigrant released from prison. He returns to the Five Points seeking revenge against his father's killer, William Cutting (Daniel Day-Lewis), a powerful anti-immigrant gang leader. He knows that revenge can only be attained by infiltrating Cutting's inner circle. Amsterdam's journey becomes a fight for personal survival and to find a place for the Irish people in the 1860's New York. - Leonardo DiCaprio, Daniel Day-Lewis, Cameron Diaz, Liam Neeson, Jim Broadbent (Historical drama, Crime drama)

programme.title: The Outlaws
programme.desc: A group of outlaws awaken to their empty train heist bag. Interrogations begin as each cowboy becomes the focus in an attempt to unmask the thief among them. Tensions mount as each bandit struggles to clear their name before bullets fly. - Eric Roberts, Liam James Collins, Dallas Hart, Jonathan Peacy, Arthur Sylense (Crime drama, Mystery)

programme.title: Wild Wild West
programme.desc: When President Ulysses S. Grant (Kevin Kline) learns that diabolical inventor Dr. Arliss Loveless (Kenneth Branagh) is planning to assassinate him, he orders Civil War hero James West (Will Smith) and U.S. Marshal Artemus Gordon (also Kline) to arrest him. West's trigger-happy personality doesn't always mesh well with that of the thoughtful Gordon, but they manage to work together. And with the help of a mysterious stranger (Salma Hayek), West and Gordon close in on Loveless. - Will Smith, Kevin Kline, Kenneth Branagh, Salma Hayek, Ted Levine (Action, Western, Comedy, Adventure, Science fiction)

programme.title: Edge of Tomorrow
programme.desc: When Earth falls under attack from invincible aliens, no military unit in the world is able to beat them. Maj. William Cage (Tom Cruise), an officer who has never seen combat, is assigned to a suicide mission. Killed within moments, Cage finds himself thrown into a time loop, in which he relives the same brutal fight -- and his death -- over and over again. However, Cage's fighting skills improve with each encore, bringing him and a comrade (Emily Blunt) ever closer to defeating the aliens. - Tom Cruise, Emily Blunt, Brendan Gleeson, Bill Paxton, Jonas Armstrong (Science fiction, Action, Adventure)

programme.title: Quantum of Solace
programme.desc: James Bond's (Daniel Craig) hunt for those responsible for Vesper Lynd's death leads him to a ruthless businessman (Mathieu Amalric) who is plotting to seize control of a valuable resource.

programme.title: Super
programme.desc: After his wife (Liv Tyler) leaves him, a fry cook (Rainn Wilson) emulates a TV superhero and transforms himself into a costumed vigilante.

programme.title: Shell
programme.desc: Desperate to reclaim her career, once-beloved actress Samantha Lake gets drawn into the glamorous world of wellness mogul Zoe Shannon, only to uncover a monstrous truth beneath the seemingly flawless surface.

programme.title: The Honey Trap: A True Story of Love, Lies and the FBI
programme.desc: The story of Denis Cuspert, aka Deso Dogg, and his journey from infamous German rapper to ISIS recruiter; exploring the circular relationship between propaganda, recruitment and the soft power of entertainment culture.

programme.title: Wolves
programme.desc: A talented high school basketball player's (Taylor John Smith) dreams of playing college ball are jeopardized by his hard-drinking father's (Michael Shannon) compulsive gambling.

programme.title: Personality Crisis: One Night Only
programme.desc: A portrait of musician David Johansen from Martin Scorsese and David Tedeschi; featuring a live performance at Café Carlyle in New York City, along with new and archival interviews.

programme.title: B******': The Sound and Fury of Rick James
programme.desc: A raw and intimate documentary look at the wildly colorful life of legendary funk artist Rick James; original interviews with artists, collaborators and friends.

programme.title: Before Dawn
programme.desc: A young man joins his countrymen on the Western front of World War I, hoping to expedite an end to the bloody conflict. However, as the battle rages on, he's forced to grapple with the brutal realities of trench warfare.

programme.title: Rumours
programme.desc: Leaders of the world's wealthiest democracies become spectacles of incompetence, contending with increasingly surreal obstacles as night falls in the misty woods, and they realize they are suddenly alone.

programme.title: Masterminds
programme.desc: An armored-car driver (Zach Galifianakis) helps a flirty co-worker (Kristen Wiig) and her friends pull off a heist, then finds himself holding the bag after they double-cross him.

programme.title: Guns Up
programme.desc: After a job goes horribly wrong, a man who moonlights as a mob henchman has one night to get his family out of the city while keeping his dark secret hidden.

programme.title: Lara Croft Tomb Raider: The Cradle of Life
programme.desc: A globe-trotter (Angelina Jolie) must find Pandora's box before a maniacal scientist (Ciarán Hinds) can harness its power for world domination.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - Seafood
programme.desc: Andrew makes cooking with live sea urchin and scallops easy by demonstrating how they should be handled; he cracks and shucks his ingredients to pair them with a cucumber mignonette and then cooks a seafood risotto. (Sports, Outdoors)

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - Mackerel
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern champions the overlooked mackerel with a main salad of pickled filets and summer sides. (Sports, Outdoors)

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - Squid
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern tackles fresh squid, demonstrating how to break down this often-intimidating seafood for two dishes; he starts by showing viewers the essential technique of cleaning and preparing squid. (Sports, Outdoors)

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - Guinea Hen
programme.desc: Chef Andrew Zimmern showcases the versatility of guinea hen, an often-overlooked game bird that offers richer flavor than commercial poultry; he begins with a guinea hen and watercress salad. (Sports, Outdoors)

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - Venison
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern demonstrates two distinct approaches to cooking venison; he begins with a venison paillarde, where tenderloin medallions are pounded thin, quickly grilled to a medium-rare. (Sports, Outdoors)

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - Halibut
programme.desc: Chef Andrew Zimmern showcases two different approaches to preparing California halibut; he begins with a Mediterranean-inspired dish, grilled halibut filets with a Spanish romesco sauce and caveman-style whole roasted cabbage. (Sports, Outdoors)

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - Quail
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern explores the nature of quail with two distinct recipes; he starts with his take on Southern comfort food, fried quail with lemon-basil aioli, where tender pieces of quail are double-dredged and fried. (Sports, Outdoors)

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - Wild Mushrooms
programme.desc: Chef Andrew Zimmern explores Minnesota's forests, creating meals from wild, foraged mushrooms; he begins with a simple grilled wild mushroom salad, paired with fresh herbs and a sherry vinaigrette. (Sports, Outdoors)

programme.title: City of God
programme.desc: In the poverty-stricken favelas of Rio de Janeiro in the 1970s, two young men choose different paths. Rocket (Phellipe Haagensen) is a budding photographer who documents the increasing drug-related violence of his neighborhood. José "Zé" Pequeno (Douglas Silva) is an ambitious drug dealer who uses Rocket and his photos as a way to increase his fame as a turf war erupts with his rival, "Knockout Ned" (Leandro Firmino da Hora). The film was shot on location in Rio's poorest neighborhoods. - Alexandre Rodrigues, Leandro Firmino da Hora, Phellipe Haagensen, Douglas Silva, Jonathan Haagensen (Crime drama, Drama)

programme.title: City of Men
programme.desc: Childhood friends Ace (Douglas Silva) and Wallace (Darlan Cunha) are both approaching their 18th birthdays. Ace struggles to raise his son alone after the mother takes a job in São Paulo, while Wallace embarks on a search for his long-missing father (Rodrigo dos Santos), whom he eventually finds having just finished serving 15 years in prison. Newly discovered secrets about the past will test Ace and Wallace's friendship as they find themselves on opposite sides of a gang war. - Douglas Silva, Darlan Cunha, Jonathan Haagensen, Rodrigo dos Santos, Eduardo BR (Drama, Crime drama)

programme.title: Queen of the Desert
programme.desc: Gertrude Bell's life as an explorer, cartographer, and archaeologist for the British Empire. - Nicole Kidman, James Franco, Robert Pattinson, Damian Lewis, Jenny Agutter (Biography, Historical drama)

programme.title: Middle School: The Worst Years of My Life
programme.desc: Rafe Khatchadorian (Griffin Gluck) has an epic imagination and a slight problem with authority, and these things collide when he transfers to a middle school where students are expected to follow the rules. This doesn't sit well with Rafe. With help from his new friend Leo (Thomas Barbusca), the mischievous lad concocts schemes to drive his tyrannical principal (Andy Daly) crazy while also using his charm and wits to impress a girl (Isabela Moner) and battle the bullies. - Griffin Gluck, Lauren Graham, Rob Riggle, Thomas Barbusca, Andy Daly (Children, Comedy, Animated)

programme.title: The Wild Thornberrys Movie
programme.desc: The Wild Thornberrys feature film finds one of America's favorite animated families going on wild adventures around the world. Now, 12-year-old Eliza is in Africa where she meets a mysterious shaman who grants her the power to talk to animals. But there's a catch -- if she reveals her gift she will lose it forever. One day Eliza discovers that poachers plan to kill an elephant herd with an electrified fence and she and Darwin, her pet chimp, must stop them. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure, Fantasy)

programme.title: Justin Bieber: Never Say Never
programme.desc: A young singing sensation prepares to dazzle the crowd at a sold-out show at Madison Square Garden. Legions of adoring Bieber fans scream as he takes center stage for a memorable night of music. Concert footage mixes with home videos of Justin playing drums and showcasing his talent. - Boyz II Men (Documentary)

programme.title: Hardball
programme.desc: Conor (Keanu Reeves) is a ticket scalper, gambler and, now, Little League coach for a rag-tag team of kids in one of the toughest part of Chicago. He's no role model, but his buddy Jimmy won't help him pay off his gambling debts unless Conor coaches Jimmy's corporately sponsored team. Surprising even himself, Conor becomes attached to his players -- and to their attractive schoolteacher (Diane Lane) -- and drawn into their tough and sometimes tragic lives. - Keanu Reeves, Diane Lane, John Hawkes, Bryan C. Hearne, Julian Griffith (Drama, Comedy)

programme.title: Dreamland
programme.desc: A teen bounty hunter is torn between helping or capturing a seductive fugitive bank robber hiding in his small town during the Great Depression. - Margot Robbie, Travis Fimmel, Garrett Hedlund, Kerry Condon, Finn Cole (Drama, Thriller)

programme.title: Raging Grace
programme.desc: Nothing is as it seems when an undocumented Filipina immigrant takes a job as a caretaker for a terminally ill man in a lavish home. She and her daughter soon become ensnared by a terrible secret that threatens to tear them apart. - Max Eigenmann, Jaeden Boadilla, Leanne Best, David Hayman, Oliver Wellington (Horror, Drama, Mystery)

programme.title: Venom
programme.desc: Gas station owner Ray (Rick Cramer) saves an elderly voodoo priestess trapped inside a wrecked car, but then he opens her mysterious suitcase and becomes possessed by the evil spirits it contains. Ray turns into a murderous zombie, killing anything that crosses his path and terrorizing a group of teens, including his own son, Sean (D.J. Cotrona). With the help and charms of the voodoo priestess, Sean and friends fight to stay alive as they are pursued through the bayou. - Agnes Bruckner, Jonathan Jackson, Laura Ramsey, D.J. Cotrona, Rick Cramer (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: Scream 4
programme.desc: It has been many years since the Ghostface Killer cut a deadly path through the town of Woodsboro. In order to get over the trauma of those horrific events, Sidney Prescott (Neve Campbell) has written a self-help book. She returns to Woodsboro for her book tour, and reconnects with old friends Gale Weathers (Courteney Cox) and Sheriff Dewey (David Arquette). However, Sidney's arrival also sparks the return of Ghostface, putting Sidney and everyone she loves in danger. - Neve Campbell, Courteney Cox, David Arquette, Emma Roberts, Mary McDonnell (Horror, Comedy)

programme.title: Jackass: The Movie
programme.desc: In this comedic documentary, Johnny Knoxville heads a crew of stuntmen, skateboarders and all-around lunatics as they prank, embarrass and torture each other in the name of fun. The antics range from childlike -- the boys don panda suits for a romp through Tokyo -- to grotesque and life-threatening. A golf cart demolition derby turns downright dangerous. Live gators nearly chomp maniac Steve-O. Filmmaker Spike Jonze and Knoxville, in heavy makeup, test the public's patience for the elderly. (Comedy, Docudrama)

programme.title: Jackass: Number Two
programme.desc: Daredevils (Johnny Knoxville, Bam Margera, Steve-O) go for the gross-out when they subject an unsuspecting public to more outrageous stunts and practical jokes. Danger, pain and bodily fluids are in plentiful supply as the gang tries to up the ante in the continuous quest to shock and annoy. (Comedy, Docudrama)

programme.title: Jackass 3
programme.desc: Johnny Knoxville, Bam Margera, Steve-O, Wee Man and the rest of their fearless and foolhardy friends take part in another round of outrageous pranks and stunts. In addition to standing in the path of a charging bull, launching themselves into the air and crashing through various objects, the guys perform in segments such as "Sweatsuit Cocktail," "Beehive Tetherball" and "Lamborghini Tooth Pull." (Comedy, Docudrama)

programme.title: Men, Women & Children
programme.desc: Like many Americans, average suburbanite Don Truby and his 15-year-old son use the Internet for information, communication and viewing pornography. Don's son Chris also maintains sexually explicit conversations with classmate Hannah, an aspiring actress whose mother posts pictures of her daughter on a modeling Website. In sharp contrast, overprotective mom Patricia Beltmeyer does everything in her power to protect her daughter from the digital age. - Rosemarie DeWitt, Jennifer Garner, Judy Greer, Dean Norris, Adam Sandler (Drama)

programme.title: Seaside
programme.desc: A woman decides to run away to the Oregon coast with her boyfriend when he inherits a family beach house. - Ariana DeBose, Matt Shingledecker, Steffanie Leigh, Sharon Washington, Jana Lee Hamblin (Thriller, Drama)

programme.title: Detainee 001
programme.desc: The complex legal story of John Walker Lindh, a young American who fell under the spell of the Taliban in Afghanistan. (Special, Documentary)

programme.title: War Pony
programme.desc: The interlocking stories of two young Oglala Lakota men grappling with a world built against them as they navigate their unique paths to manhood. - Jojo Bapteise Whiting, LaDainian Crazy Thunder, Ashley Shelton, Robert Stover, Jesse Schmockel (Drama)

programme.title: Our Friend
programme.desc: After Nicole and Matthew receive life-altering news, the couple find unexpected support from their friend Dane, who puts his own life on hold to move into their family home. - Jason Segel, Dakota Johnson, Casey Affleck, Isabella Kai Rice, Violet McGraw (Drama)

programme.title: Paranormal Activity
programme.desc: Soon after moving into a suburban tract home, Katie (Katie Featherston) and Micah (Micah Sloat) become increasingly disturbed by what appears to be a supernatural presence. Hoping to capture evidence of it on film, they set up video cameras in the house but are not prepared for the terrifying events that follow. - Katie Featherston, Micah Sloat, Amber Armstrong, Mark Fredrichs, Ashley Palmer (Horror, Thriller, Mystery)

programme.title: Carriers
programme.desc: When a virus threatens to wipe out humanity, Danny (Lou Taylor Pucci), his brother Brian (Chris Pine), and their friends Bobby (Piper Perabo) and Kate (Emily VanCamp) set out across the desert in the Southwest, trying to elude the pandemic. Over the course of several days, the four friends learn that the darkness within themselves may prove deadlier than any microbe. - Lou Taylor Pucci, Chris Pine, Piper Perabo, Emily VanCamp, Christopher Meloni (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: Jenny's Wedding
programme.desc: When Jenny (Katherine Heigl) decides to marry a woman (Alexis Bledel), her conventional family must accept who she is or risk losing her forever. - Katherine Heigl, Tom Wilkinson, Linda Emond, Grace Gummer, Alexis Bledel (Romantic comedy, LGBTQ, Drama)

programme.title: Brave the Dark
programme.desc: When Mr. Deen discovers one of his students has been living out of his car and thrown into jail, he decides to bail him out. Determined to curb Nate's self-destructive behavior, Mr. Deen discovers a host of secrets that are slowly tearing Nate apart. - Nicholas Hamilton, Jared Harris, Sasha Bhasin, Will Price, Jamie Harris (Drama)

programme.title: Old Guy
programme.desc: An aging hit man must train a young prodigy when his employer moves to replace the old guard. However, when they learn they're being betrayed, the unlikely pair turns into a lethal team -- with their double-crossing bosses in their sights. - Christoph Waltz, Lucy Liu, Cooper Hoffman, Ryan McParland, Ann Akinjirin (Action, Comedy)

programme.title: Regarding Us
programme.desc: After losing her teaching career in the Catholic school system, a transgender woman has a profound impact on the lives of two children, one with two fathers in marital strife, and the other a recent transplant from a conservative household. When the children form a unique bond, new questions and old prejudices erupt. - Alexandra Grey, David Beck, Jacob Moran, Hudson Paul, Fiona Morgan Quinn (Drama, Comedy)

programme.title: Lilies Not for Me
programme.desc: In the 1920s England, a gay novelist and his psychiatric nurse form an unlikely friendship over a series of doctor-prescribed "dates." Through their conversations, he tells her the story of his relationship with an old friend which spiraled out of control when they turned to a risky procedure to cure themselves of their forbidden feelings for one another. - Fionn O'Shea, Robert Aramayo, Erin Kellyman, Louis Hofmann, Jodi Balfour (Drama, Romance)

programme.title: Peep World
programme.desc: Revelations arise when members (Michael C. Hall, Sarah Silverman) of a dysfunctional Jewish family gather to celebrate the patriarch's (Ron Rifkin) 70th birthday.

programme.title: Jackass Presents: Bad Grandpa
programme.desc: Irving Zisman (Johnny Knoxville) takes his young and impressionable grandson (Jackson Nicoll) on a cross-country trip in which they encounter male strippers, biker-bar patrons and other unsuspecting citizens.

programme.title: Good Kill
programme.desc: An Air Force drone pilot (Ethan Hawke) begins to question the ethics of dropping bombs on Afghanistan from the safety of his post in Las Vegas.

programme.title: Paranormal Activity 3
programme.desc: A videographer becomes obsessed with finding the source of disturbing late-night noises in his home and discovers its terrifying origin.

programme.title: Congo
programme.desc: Killer gorillas menace an ex-CIA agent (Laura Linney), a primatologist (Dylan Walsh) and others on a mission in Africa.

programme.title: Rebel in the Rye
programme.desc: Author J.D. Salinger leads a reclusive lifestyle after the success of his popular and controversial novel The Catcher in the Rye.

programme.title: Wolves
programme.desc: A talented high school basketball player's (Taylor John Smith) dreams of playing college ball are jeopardized by his hard-drinking father's (Michael Shannon) compulsive gambling.

programme.title: Monstrous
programme.desc: A terrifying new horror awaits Laura and her 7-year-old son, Cody, when they flee her abusive ex-husband and try to settle into a new life. Still traumatized, their fragile existence is pushed to the breaking point.

programme.title: South Park: Bigger, Longer & Uncut
programme.desc: Kyle, Stan and Cartman orchestrate a resistance to an imminent war between Canada and the United States.

programme.title: The Tribes of Palos Verdes
programme.desc: When the situation at her idyllic Palos Verdes home turns volatile, young Medina attempts to surf her way to happiness.

programme.title: Baby Driver
programme.desc: Coerced into working for a crime boss, a talented getaway driver must face the music when a doomed heist threatens his life, love and freedom.

programme.title: Spontaneous
programme.desc: When students in their high school inexplicably start to explode, seniors Mara and Dylan struggle to survive in a world where each moment may be their last.

programme.title: Mission Saving Paradise - Part 2

programme.title: The International SeaKeepers Society

programme.title: Best in Show
programme.desc: The tension is palpable, the excitement is mounting and the heady scent of competition is in the air as hundreds of eager contestants from across America prepare to take part in what is undoubtedly one of the greatest events of their lives -- the Mayflower Dog Show. The canine contestants and their owners are as wondrously diverse as the great country that has bred them. - Michael Hitchcock, Parker Posey, Eugene Levy, Catherine O'Hara, Christopher Guest (Comedy, LGBTQ)

programme.title: Bad News Bears
programme.desc: Morris Buttermaker is a burned-out minor league baseball player who loves to drink and can't keep his hands to himself. His long-suffering lawyer arranges for him to manage a local Little League team, and Buttermaker soon finds himself the head of a rag-tag group of misfit players. Through unconventional team-building exercises and his offbeat coaching style, Buttermaker helps his hapless Bears prepare to meet their rivals, the Yankees. - Billy Bob Thornton, Greg Kinnear, Marcia Gay Harden, Sammi Kane Kraft, Ridge Canipe (Comedy)

programme.title: Emily Bronte's Wuthering Heights
programme.desc: Young orphan Heathcliff (Ralph Fiennes) is adopted by the wealthy Earnshaw family and moves into their estate, Wuthering Heights. Soon, the new resident falls for his compassionate foster sister, Cathy (Juliette Binoche). The two share a remarkable bond that seems unbreakable until Cathy, feeling the pressure of social convention, suppresses her feelings and marries Edgar Linton (Simon Shepherd), a man of means who befits her stature. Heathcliff vows to win her back. - Juliette Binoche, Ralph Fiennes, Janet McTeer, Sophie Ward, Simon Shepherd (Drama)

programme.title: Serendipity
programme.desc: On a magical night when they are in their 20s, Jonathan (John Cusack) meets Sara (Kate Beckinsale). He finds it love at first sight, but Sara believes in destiny. After 10 years the two -- with 3,000 miles between them -- must decide if fate wants them to be together again. When love feels like magic, it is called destiny; when destiny has a sense of humor, it is serendipity. - John Cusack, Kate Beckinsale, Molly Shannon, Jeremy Piven, John Corbett (Romantic comedy)

programme.title: Win a Date With Tad Hamilton!
programme.desc: Pete (Topher Grace), the quirky, self-deprecating manager of a grocery store, is madly in love with his best friend, Rosalee (Kate Bosworth). Unfortunately, she has absolutely no idea. When Rosalee wins a date with her favorite actor, the smarmy Tad Hamilton (Josh Duhamel), Pete delays admitting his feelings to her. And when the scheming Hamilton relocates to their small town to pursue Rosalee in the wake of their initial meeting, a horrified Pete must struggle to win her heart. - Kate Bosworth, Topher Grace, Josh Duhamel, Nathan Lane, Sean Hayes (Romance, Comedy, Adventure)

programme.title: Star Trek III: The Search for Spock
programme.desc: Adm. James T. Kirk (William Shatner) has defeated his archenemy but at great cost. His friend Spock has apparently been killed, the USS Enterprise is being scrapped, and starship physician Dr. Leonard "Bones" McCoy (DeForest Kelley) has taken ill. McCoy's odd behavior is evidence he's harboring Spock's katra, or animating spirit, and Kirk seeks to take the Enterprise back to the Genesis Planet and find his friend. Rebuffed, Kirk takes dramatic action that results in war with deadly Klingons. - William Shatner, DeForest Kelley, James Doohan, George Takei, Walter Koenig (Science fiction, Action, Adventure, Drama, Comedy)

programme.title: Sky Captain and the World of Tomorrow
programme.desc: When gigantic robots attack New York City, "Sky Captain" (Jude Law) uses his private air force to fight them off. His ex-girlfriend, reporter Polly Perkins (Gwyneth Paltrow), has been investigating the recent disappearance of prominent scientists. Suspecting a link between the global robot attacks and missing men, Sky Captain and Polly decide to work together. They fly to the Himalayas in pursuit of the mysterious Dr. Totenkopf (Laurence Olivier), the mastermind behind the robots. - Gwyneth Paltrow, Jude Law, Angelina Jolie, Giovanni Ribisi, Michael Gambon (Adventure, Fantasy, Science fiction, Action)

programme.title: Son of Rambow
programme.desc: In the 1980s England, schoolboys Will Proudfoot and Lee Carter meet by chance in a hallway. Though the boys are polar opposites, Lee asks Will to help him make a homemade action movie, inspired by Sylvester Stallone's hit, "Rambo: First Blood." Will, who lives in a strict religious environment, is only too happy to oblige his new friend. - Bill Milner, Will Poulter, Jules Sitruk, Jessica Stevenson, Neil Dudgeon (Comedy)

programme.title: The Lego Movie
programme.desc: An ordinary LEGO figurine Emmet who always follows the rules, is mistakenly identified as an extraordinary being and the key to saving the world. He finds himself drafted into a fellowship of strangers who are on a mission to stop an evil tyrant's plans to conquer the world. Unfortunately for Emmet, he is hopelessly and hilariously unprepared for such a task, but he'll give it his all nonetheless. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure, Action)

He quickly becomes the big man on campus thanks to his football skills, but when his Jewish background is discovered, his worst fears are realized and his friends (Matt Damon, Chris O'Donnell) turn on him with violent threats and public ridicule. - Brendan Fraser, Matt Damon, Chris O'Donnell, Randall Batinkoff, Andrew Lowery (Drama)

programme.title: 72 Hours to Survive - Canoe Survival
programme.desc: S1E4 - Dale heads out for a solo canoe trip on Lesser Salve Lake. The episode begins with the canoe tipping over into the water. Dale loses all his gear and food. Dale must use only what he had in his PFD and pockets for 72 hours until rescue. (Adventure)

programme.title: 704 Outdoors - Grinding on the Medio
programme.desc: During this Texas hunt, the team battles extreme fog but keeps digging and still manages to be successful. (Outdoors)

programme.title: Water Ways - Toronto
programme.desc: S4E10 - Steven Bull helps a search and rescue team save Bob the dummy, discovers one of Canada's only nautical-themed bookstores and gets a look at the Toronto Police Marine unit. (Boat)

programme.title: Sportfishing on the Fly - Spring Chironomids
programme.desc: Host Don Freschi shares his experiences, tips and tricks as he fishes rivers, lakes and oceans. (Fishing)

programme.title: Waterfowl East - Valentine Closer
programme.desc: S2E4 - The crew makes their way back down to Grand Manan to close out the sea duck season with a blast. (Hunting)

programme.title: Dirt Nap TV - Muzzleloading Meat Hunts
programme.desc: S6E10 - It's time to fill the freezer. Join along as Adam and Andy put down the bows and pick up the muzzleloaders. (Hunting, Outdoors)

programme.title: Aventures Express.TV - Le tahr de la Nouvelle-Zélande
programme.desc: S4E9 (Nature, Adventure)

programme.title: Road Trip Angler - Adventures in St. Marks Florida
programme.desc: S5E2 - Jameson Redding is exploring St. Marks, Florida, along with his friend Chris Funk trying to catch a species of Bass that is unique to the area. (Fishing, Outdoors)

programme.title: The Choice - Home Range Bull Elk '26
programme.desc: The Cianciarulos, along with friends and family, put a whitetail approach to the test during Southern Colorado's archery elk season. Hunting their home properties from tree stands and their RAM Blind. (Hunting)

programme.title: Trigger Time TV - Tips From the Pros
programme.desc: Aiming techniques, prepping your gun/mantis Blackbeard, GAP program and setting up your ballistic solver. (Outdoors, Documentary)

programme.title: Whitetail Frenzy - Triple Threat: Doe Hunts, SC Hogs and Urban Whitetail
programme.desc: This week on Whitetail Frenzy, we're serving up a triple dose of hunting action! Watch as hunters take on the Governor's One Shot doe challenge, then head south for some intense South Carolina hog hunting. (Hunting)

programme.title: Mitchell Payment's Moment of Truth TV - Digging Deep
programme.desc: S9E4 - Mitchell grinds it out, with his prime bow in hand, pursuing whitetail bucks. (Outdoors)

programme.title: Hard Truths of Conservation - Secrets of Africa
programme.desc: S4E10 - In Namibia, Dan Cabela visits conservationist Robin Hurt to see how private land ownership and hunting have restored the landscape to a thriving wildlife area. (Docudrama, Science, Nature, Animals, Documentary)

programme.title: Game On With Blaine Anthony - Bulls of the Pine Tree State
programme.desc: There's nothing quite like hunting in your backyard, & Blaine Anthony is living proof as he tackles Maine's legendary moose with a hard-earned permit.The Pine Tree State's massive bulls have been calling his name for years, & now it's time to answer. (Hunting, Outdoors)

programme.title: Weird Hunts - Fishing for Deer
programme.desc: S2E5 - Matt breaks out the fishing line again to go deer hunting but this time, the line is attached to his crossbow that's sitting on the other side of the pond; he then heads out west and hops on a powerboat to chase down some gobblers. (Hunting)

programme.title: Rockyzone Outdoors - Backcountry Bass Fishing
programme.desc: S2E2 - Luca heads out with his brother Jesse for bass opener on a remote backcountry lake; together, they hike 5 km through the woods to reach a hidden hotspot known for its largemouth bass, putting in the work to access untouched water. (Fishing)

programme.title: How to Hunt With Ryan Kohler - Chasing Spring Giants Part 1
programme.desc: S10E1 - Ryan and Zack revisit the opening hunts of the season, from a giant boar at close range to Corey's personal-best bear and the stories behind two camp legends: Cocaine Bear and Sweet Tooth. (Hunting, Outdoors, Reality)

programme.title: The Mellon Patch, It's a Family Thing - The Pheasant Chicks Arrive!
programme.desc: S1E4 - Rich and Sandi show the building of the new pheasant coop and the arrival of 400 pheasant chicks.

programme.title: Northeast Untamed - My First Bear Hunt
programme.desc: S1E4 - This week, Ben, Matt and Wes head into the bear blind in hopes of bagging a New Brunswick black bear. (Outdoors, Hunting)

programme.title: Claudio Ongaro's Hired to Hunt - Best Hired to Hunt: A Look to the Past
programme.desc: S8E10 - A look back at some great moments from "Hired to Hunt"'s past. (Outdoors)

programme.title: Deer & Deer Hunting - Timing of the Rut
programme.desc: S22E10 - Contributor Mark Kayser breaks down the whitetail rut and how you as a hunter can take advantage of the perfect timing. (Hunting, Outdoors)

programme.title: Aventures Express.TV - Best of (New)
programme.desc: S4E10 (Nature, Adventure)

programme.title: Bloodline Adventures TV - What Happens May Long Weekend?
programme.desc: S1E10 - A True May Long Weekend Experience for the Bloodline Adventures Crew! (Hunting)

programme.title: Beyond the Blind Hunts - Greenbacks of Big Windy (New)
programme.desc: S1E10 - The Interlake Destroyers take us on a two-season adventure chasing Lake Winnipegs legendary greenback walleyes. (Hunting)

programme.title: The Way It Was TV - From Ok to La
programme.desc: The hosts join Kenny Covington for a hunting trip in Oklahoma; The Rev takes on whitetail hunting, testing his skills in Texas and on his own property back home. (Hunting, Outdoors)
